The *Piṇḍolabhāradvājattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 10) is a biographical verse text located in the Therāpadāna section of the late canonical Pali collection [SuttaCentral]. The text recounts the past-life meritorious deeds and attainments of the elder Piṇḍola Bhāradvāja. On SuttaCentral, five modern translations across five languages are registered for this poem [SuttaCentral].

Additionally, stock metrical sequences—especially the recurring formulaic block spanning segments §14.3–16.1—are shared with multiple other apadāna texts, notably the *Raṭṭhapālattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 20), *Cūḷapanthakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 16), *Rāhulattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 18), *Pilindavacchattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 393), and *Puṇṇamantāṇiputtattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 7) [DharmaNexus].
